items.title: Hibana fast profile runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 101 tok/s on one DGX Spark
items.summary: A Hibana 'fast' setting for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a single DGX Spark reports 101.3 tok/s plain-text decode versus 46.6 for a common NVFP4 plus MTP recipe, 133.3 on code and 252.9 aggregate over four streams (3-run median, 512 tokens, temperature 0). A compose recipe and repo are linked.

doubt.pushback: Single-author benchmark on one machine; no third-party reproduction seen.

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini's bundled draft model lifts SGLang decode on a DGX Spark from 37 to 83 tok/s
items.summary: Inkling 2 Mini ships a draft model inside its download; on a DGX Spark under SGLang decode rises from 37 to 83 tok/s, holds at a 32k prompt, and the gain falls to about 1.5x at temperature 1.

doubt.pushback: Quote of another user's measurement; not independently reproduced.

items.title: Scarlet open-source AI video editor adds Gemini support, frame annotations and a B-roll planner
items.summary: Scarlet, an open-source AI video editor driven by Claude, Codex and now Gemini, adds drawing on frames to mark edits, smarter screen-demo zoom and camera placement, lip-sync fixes, zero-token reject and undo, and a B-roll planner.

doubt.pushback: Not deep-read; announcement by the project's maker, no independent test seen.

items.title: Inference Stack bundles vLLM, llm-d, LiteLLM and Grafana as a one-click self-hosted deploy
items.summary: A new Inference Stack product deploys vLLM, Hugging Face model discovery, llm-d routing, LiteLLM and Grafana metrics together in one click for self-hosted inference.

doubt.pushback: Launch post only; no repo, docs or measurements checked.
